name: Northern Mariana Islands
flagName: Flag of the Northern Mariana Islands
summary: A blue field with a white star over a grey latte stone, encircled by a wreath of flowers. The latte stone is a pillar used in ancient Chamorro buildings.
origin: The flag was first adopted in 1972, while the islands were part of the UN Trust Territory, and modified in 1985 by adding the flower wreath (mwarmwar), a traditional Carolinian headpiece.

symbols.name: Latte stone
symbols.description: A grey stone pillar with a capstone.
symbols.meaning: Chamorro culture; latte stones supported ancient houses.

symbols.name: Star
symbols.description: A white five-pointed star over the stone.

symbols.name: Flower wreath
symbols.description: A mwarmwar of flowers around the star and stone.

history.label: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

facts: The islands became a US commonwealth in 1986.
clues: Blue with a white star over a grey stone pillar in a flower wreath.
Its stone pillar is from ancient Chamorro houses.
